if (!(Test-Path 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft\jdk-17*')) { winget install Microsoft.OpenJDK.17 --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements }; $jdk = (Get-ChildItem 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft\jdk-17*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).FullName; if ($jdk) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('JAVA_HOME', $jdk, 'User'); $p = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'User'); if ($p -notmatch [regex]::Escape("$jdk\bin")) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', "$p;$jdk\bin", 'User') }; $env:JAVA_HOME = $jdk; $env:Path += ";$jdk\bin"; Write-Host '[✓] JDK Setup Complete!' -ForegroundColor Green; java -version }
